content: {DRAFT} When a Null pointer has been passed to a CanNm service, the called function shall not be executed and it shall return E_NOT_OK to the calling function if applicable. If development error detection is enabled ( CanNmDevErrorDetec t is set to TRUE ) the corresponding error CANNM_E_PARAM_POINTER shall be reported to DET.
